prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in Hinglish (Roman script) for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Subhash bhai, Subhash I., Suresh bhai, Deepak bhai.
The chat covers 24/03/26, 7:30 pm to 24/03/26, 9:30 pm. It must have exactly 25 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
24/03/26, 8:30 pm - Subhash bhai: Deepak bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
text:
24/03/26, 7:30 pm - Suresh bhai: Aaj ka total dukan ka cash aur UPI tally hua ki nahi?
24/03/26, 7:35 pm - Deepak bhai: Haan Suresh bhai, main wahi accounts dekh raha hoon.
24/03/26, 7:38 pm - Subhash I.: Sharma ji ne jo 15,000 ka UPI payment kiya tha uska screenshot mila?
24/03/26, 7:42 pm - Deepak bhai: Haan screenshot to aaya hai, par bank app me credit show nahi ho raha.
24/03/26, 7:45 pm - Suresh bhai: Aisa kaise? Fake screenshot to nahi hai?
24/03/26, 7:50 pm - Subhash I.: Aaj kal QR code scam aur fake app wala fraud bohot chal raha hai.
24/03/26, 7:55 pm - Deepak bhai: Haan, main bank statement check kar raha hoon dobara.
24/03/26, 8:02 pm - Subhash bhai: Subhash I. tum distributor ko payment bhej diye kya?
24/03/26, 8:10 pm - Subhash I.: Nahi Subhash bhai, abhi tak verification pending hai.
24/03/26, 8:15 pm - Suresh bhai: Training session me bataya tha ki bina bank balance hit hue delivery mat do.
24/03/26, 8:20 pm - Deepak bhai: Ek extra entry dikh rahi hai ledger me 25,000 ki.
24/03/26, 8:25 pm - Subhash I.: Kaunsi entry? Mujhe to ledger me clear dikh raha tha.
24/03/26, 8:30 pm - Subhash bhai: Deepak bhai, ye entry abhi delete kar do, kisi ko mat batana
24/03/26, 8:32 pm - Deepak bhai: Thik hai Subhash bhai, kar deta hoon.
24/03/26, 8:36 pm - Suresh bhai: Kya baate chal rahi hai? Kisi ko fraud ka doubt hai kya?
24/03/26, 8:40 pm - Subhash I.: Haan Suresh bhai, Sharma ji wale transaction ka reference number match nahi kar raha.
24/03/26, 8:45 pm - Suresh bhai: Ye to direct UPI spoofing lag rahi hai.
24/03/26, 8:50 pm - Deepak bhai: Main bank helpline pe call karke transaction status confirm karta hoon.
24/03/26, 8:55 pm - Subhash bhai: Helpline pe mat karo abhi, kal subah branch chale jayenge.
24/03/26, 9:02 pm - Subhash I.: Fraud training register me is case ko log karna padega na?
24/03/26, 9:10 pm - Suresh bhai: Bilkul, training module 4 ke hisab se cyber cell ko inform bhi karna chahiye.
24/03/26, 9:15 pm - Deepak bhai: Main training checklist ke sare points submit kar raha hoon.
24/03/26, 9:20 pm - Subhash I.: Subhash bhai aapne ledger ka backup liya tha na?
24/03/26, 9:25 pm - Subhash bhai: Haan backup safe hai, tension mat lo.
24/03/26, 9:30 pm - Suresh bhai: Chalo kal subah training case review meeting me milte hain.
